title: Toddler in Overalls with Ball, Garden Yard - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot capturing a curly-haired toddler in mid-stride across a grassy backyard lawn. The child wears light-colored overalls over a short-sleeved shirt and clutches a large woven or knitted toy ball. Strong sunlight casts distinct shadows onto the lawn and an adjacent stucco wall, behind which stands a mature tree and a vintage garden bench.
